source.agreement_type: Amended and Restated Credit Agreement (Farm Credit facility; AgWest Farm Credit, PCA as Administrative Agent)
source.notes: filing_date taken from the EDGAR index for accession 0001679273-24-000026; the exhibit states only the 2024-05-03 agreement date. CORPUS-FRAME FLAG: Schedule 2.01 lists a single Lender of record (AgWest Farm Credit, PCA, 100% of every tranche). The ~13 other Farm Credit institutions on the signature pages are Voting Participants under Section 11.06(e), not Lenders on the commitment schedule. The frame requires an Administrative Agent and >=3 lenders on the commitment schedule; as literally written this document fails that test even though it is economically syndicated and has an agent and a margin grid. Decide whether it stays before scoring anything against it. Also note the structure is term-loan-only (three TLA tranches, no revolver), which is outside the three stratification buckets. SECOND FLAG, added on review: this accession contains two credit agreements. EX-10.1 (ex10_1conformed-lwxbofax.htm) is the Bank of America agreement; this is EX-10.2, the AgWest Farm Credit facility. corpus.md selected 'Lamb Weston Holdings' for 'revolver + TLA / Lettered TLA with no grid', which describes neither this document nor its screen record accurately.

citation.quote: “Term A Maturity Date” means June 28, 2026

maturity_date.notes: June 28, 2026 is a Sunday. The 'Maturity Date' definition provides that if the date is not a Business Day, the Maturity Date is the next preceding Business Day (Friday, June 26, 2026). Stated date recorded; the adjustment is ordinary mechanics, treated like the 'earliest of' construction.

citation.quote: “Benchmark” means, initially, the Adjusted Term SOFR Rate

interest_rate_benchmark.notes: Section 2.08(a)(i): Term SOFR Loans bear interest at Adjusted Term SOFR Rate plus Applicable Rate. Adjusted Term SOFR = Term SOFR Rate + SOFR Adjustment (CSA of 0.10%/0.10%/0.25%); adjusted variant maps to term_sofr. Term SOFR Administrator is CME Group Benchmark Administration Limited. Base Rate is the alternative, not the answer.

citation.quote: “Applicable Rate” means, from time to time, the following percentages per annum, based upon the Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio as set forth in the most recent Compliance Certificate received by the Administrative Agent pursuant to Section 7.01(c)
“Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio” means, on any date, the ratio of (a) Consolidated Funded Indebtedness on such date, minus (i) unrestricted cash and Cash Equivalents of Loan Parties

covenant_type.notes: Classified by the ratio's definition: all Consolidated Funded Indebtedness (secured and unsecured), net of unrestricted cash of Loan Parties plus 100% of distributable unrestricted cash of non-Loan-Party Restricted Subsidiaries. A separate 'Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio' is defined but is not a Section 8.11 covenant.

citation.quote: After the Restatement Effective Date and prior to the last day of the Fiscal Quarter ending November 2027 5.00 to 1.00

initial_threshold.notes: First test date is the end of the first full Fiscal Quarter after the Restatement Effective Date (fiscal quarter ending August 2024). Two conditional overrides are NOT recorded as the level: (1) Acquisition Period step-up of 0.50x for four quarters after a Material Acquisition (>= $350,000,000) - the covenant holiday; (2) a tighter 3.50 to 1.00 level applicable during a Collateral and Guarantee Suspension Period (investment-grade ratings from two agencies). Section 6.13 confirms Liens are in place except during a suspension period, so no suspension period is in effect at the Restatement Effective Date.

citation.quote: On and after the last day of the Fiscal Quarter ending November 2027 4.75 to 1.00

step_down_schedule.notes: HESITATION - RULE GAP. The agreement identifies the step-down period only as 'the Fiscal Quarter ending November 2027'; it states no calendar day. Fiscal Year ends on the last Sunday in May (definition of 'Fiscal Year'); the quarter-end day is not derivable from the document without assuming a 13-week quarter, which schema.md says not to do. Recorded as ISO-8601 reduced-precision YYYY-MM rather than inventing a day. Proposed rule for schema.md: where a step-down is keyed to a fiscal period identified only by month, record YYYY-MM. If the user prefers a full date, the last Sunday of November 2027 is 2027-11-28, but that is a resolution, not a label.

free_text_notes: Document type: full Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated May 3, 2024 (in scope). Restates the June 28, 2019 Credit Agreement as amended four times. The Term A-2 Loan is refinanced by the Term A-4 Loan and does not appear as a facility.
Records created: 3 facilities (Term A, Term A-3, Term A-4 - all term_loan_a), 2 covenants (total_net_leverage, interest_coverage).
Records deliberately NOT created: Incremental Term Loan Commitments up to $100,000,000 (Section 2.01(b) accordion); Fixed Rate Loan option under the Term A-4 Loan (a pricing Type, not a tranche).
No revolver, no letter of credit or swingline sublimits, no commitment fee grid.

Lender of record: AgWest Farm Credit, PCA holds 100% of each Class per Schedule 2.01; other Farm Credit institutions participate as Voting Participants (Section 11.06(e)). See corpus-frame flag in source.notes.
Term A maturity of June 28, 2026 falls on a Sunday; the Maturity Date definition rolls it back to the preceding Business Day. Stated date recorded.
Applicable Rate opening tiers are stated for all three tranches; no silence fallback and no deferral null needed.
